question.summary: Known examples are consistent with the proposed completely bounded entropy or coherent-information conditions, but no theorem covers every multiplicativity counterexample.
question.importance: A universal entropy signature would explain why known output-norm counterexamples work and connect multiplicativity failure to coherent information.
question.unresolved: Prove the requested CB-entropy or coherent-information structure for all maximal-output-norm counterexamples, or give a counterexample to that structure.

sourceRefs.statedTitle: Do all counter-examples to multiplicativity of maximal output p-norm have non-negative CB entropy and/or zero coherent information?

claims.title: Completely bounded norms give forward additivity implications
claims.text: Devetak, Junge, King and Ruskai establish the foundational CB-norm connection, but not the converse classification requested here.

decisions.rationale: Status assessed against the archived statement in the 2026-08-12 primary-source audit; the evidence ledger lists the results considered.

editorial.interpretation: A statement that coherent information is zero must specify whether this is an input value, the channel maximum, or a capacity.
